title: Very pretty
text: Very pretty. I like this pretty autumn themed towel set. It is very cute. The towels are really mostly for decoration. They are not very good at absorbing liquids, so they aren't of much use. The hot pad, though, is adorable and does ao great job of keeping your hands shielded from hot pans. I recommend with caution, that the towels are mostly just for decor use.
